dialogueText:
Patient: Hi, I got a quote from you for my hair transplant. I wanna go ahead but I need to book my flights so is the 19th of November available?
Representative: Hi Lee, I hope you are okay. Let me check and get back to you with more details. Please give me a minute.
Representative: The 19th of November is available for your operation. If you choose this date, your schedule will be as follows:
- 18th of November: Arrival
- 19th of November: Operation date
- 20th of November: Check-up, first wash, and return date
Representative: I'm creating your reservation right now, would you like to confirm it today?
Patient: Ok I'll see if I can book a flight for 18th when I get home from work and go from there.
Representative: Perfect! I will be waiting for your message.
Representative: Hi again, I hope you are okay. Have you had the chance to check the flight tickets?
Patient: Yes mate just need to sort flights and I'm good to go.
salesNotes: Hot lead with fixed travel plans. Quick availability check and clear schedule presentation moved the patient from inquiry to booking. Follow-up on flights was timely and non-pushy.

dialogueText:
Patient: I am comparing veneer prices in Turkey. I need 16 veneers, zirconium material.
Representative: I can help you compare safely. To give you the most accurate quote, could you share close-up smile photos and tell us about any dental work you've had before? Our dentist can review them and prepare a personalised treatment plan.
Patient: I'll send photos now. What's included in the package?
Representative: Our dental package includes: VIP airport transfer, hotel accommodation during treatment, all dental sessions with our specialist, post-treatment check-up, and aftercare kit. Plus, you'll have ongoing support through our London office for any follow-up concerns.
Patient: That sounds comprehensive. When can I come?
Representative: After the dentist reviews your photos, I'll confirm the exact number of sessions needed and suggest the best dates. Most patients stay 5-7 days for a full set of veneers.
salesNotes: Price-sensitive international lead comparing clinics. Moved conversation from generic price comparison to personalised clinical review and comprehensive package value. London office mention increased trust.

dialogueText:
Patient: Hi, I'm getting married next year July, so thinking about breast uplift for now and after wedding maybe tummy area. My partner is working out the finances.
Representative: Congratulations on your upcoming wedding! I completely understand wanting to look your best. Here's what I'd suggest:
1. Breast uplift first – recovery time is about 4-6 weeks, so we can plan this well before your wedding
2. Tummy tuck after the wedding – this requires a bit more recovery time
We can offer both as a phased package, which is more budget-friendly.
Patient: That sounds good. How much for just the breast uplift for now?
Representative: To give you the most accurate quote, could you share some photos? Our surgeon will assess and provide a personalised plan. In the meantime, I can share before/after photos from similar cases.
Patient: Ok I'll send photos tonight.
Representative: Thank you! Once reviewed, I'll send you the surgeon's recommendation, package options, and available dates.
salesNotes: Bride-to-be with multiple procedure interest. Successfully phased the procedures to fit wedding timeline and budget. Partner involvement in financial decisions required transparent pricing approach.

dialogueText:
Patient: I want a nose job but I want it to look natural, not overdone. Can I see examples of your surgeon's work?
Representative: Absolutely! Natural results are our priority. I'll share some before/after photos from patients who had a similar nose structure. Could you tell me:
1. Have you had any previous nose surgery?
2. Are there specific changes you're hoping for?
Patient: No previous surgery. I mainly want the bridge smoothed and tip refined.
Representative: Great, this would be a primary rhinoplasty. For a precise assessment, could you send front-view and side-profile photos? Our surgeon will review and provide a personalised plan with expected outcomes.
Patient: I'll send them now.
Representative: Thank you! Dr. will review within 24 hours. I'll also share recovery timeline and package details including VIP transfer and hotel.
salesNotes: Patient with clear natural aesthetic expectation. Key: confirming primary vs revision status early, asking for specific goals, and doctor authority through before/after sharing.

dialogueText:
Patient: How much for a hair transplant? Just give me a price.
Representative: To provide an accurate quote, we'd need to see photos of your hair area (top, front, and donor area). The price depends on the number of grafts needed and the technique used (FUE, DHI, or Sapphire). Would you like to share some photos?
Patient: Just a ballpark figure please.
Representative: Our packages start from €2,200 and can go up to €4,500 depending on the number of grafts. But the most important thing is getting the right assessment first – a wrong graft estimate can lead to poor results.
Patient: Ok I'll think about it.
Representative: Of course! Whenever you're ready, you can send photos and we'll prepare a personalised plan with no obligation. We also have a London office if you'd prefer to discuss in person.
salesNotes: Price-only inquiry without engagement. Failed to convert to photo submission. London office offer was good but came too late. Should have led with doctor review value earlier.

dialogueText:
Patient: I want lipo and BBL. I've already had a consultation with another clinic but I want a second opinion. Can I send my medical form and photos?
Representative: Absolutely! It's very wise to get a second opinion. Please share your medical form, full-body photos, and any previous consultation notes. Our plastic surgeon will review everything and provide an honest assessment.
Patient: Sending now. I'm looking to come in September if possible.
Representative: September is a great time. Once the surgeon reviews your case, I'll confirm:
- Whether you're a suitable candidate for combined lipo + BBL
- Expected recovery timeline
- Available dates in September
- Full package pricing including VIP transfer, hotel, and aftercare
Patient: Perfect. How long do I need to stay?
Representative: Typically 7-10 days: arrival, pre-op consultation, surgery, 5-7 days recovery with check-ups, then departure. We coordinate everything including your hotel near the clinic.
salesNotes: Hot lead with clear timeline and previous consultation experience. Second opinion seekers are often close to decision. Key was accepting previous consultation notes and offering comprehensive logistics info quickly.

dialogueText:
Patient: What's the cheapest option for a full set of veneers?
Representative: Our Hollywood Smile packages vary based on material and number of teeth. The most affordable option starts at around €3,000 for composite veneers. For premium zirconium, it's around €4,500-5,500.
Patient: That's way more than I was quoted elsewhere. Thanks anyway.
Representative: I understand. Quality materials and experienced dentists do come at a cost, but we stand behind our work. Would you like me to share some before/after photos and patient reviews?
Patient: No thanks, already decided.
salesNotes: Lost deal – purely price-driven patient. Representative should have focused on clinical value, warranty, and London follow-up support before sharing prices. Always establish value before revealing numbers.
